description: Lists every card that waits for the owner, by who made it (an agent, or Marsell), each in its own line, with how many there are and where the owner answers them. Cards whose moment passed are in the freezer instead, not here: freezer_read. whatEachCost: each card with the day it was made and what making it cost in tokens, the ledger's own count from the rows of Everything Marsell did that its work logged (the owner sees the same tokens there); tokens null means its work recorded no cost, so say that, never a guess.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
